about: IIT Bhubaneswar opened in 2008 in the second wave of new IITs, on a campus on Barunei Hill in Argul, about 24 km from Bhubaneswar city. It organises teaching and research into seven interdisciplinary schools rather than single-subject departments: basic sciences, infrastructure, mechanical sciences, electrical and computer sciences, minerals and metallurgy, earth-ocean-climate sciences, and humanities-management. Undergraduate seats fill via JEE Advanced and JoSAA, mixing four-year B.Tech tracks with five-year dual-degree options. It was the first IIT to offer Odissi dance for B.Tech credit.

location.nearestAirport: Biju Patnaik International Airport, Bhubaneswar (~35 km)
location.connectivityNote: The campus sits on Barunei Hill in Argul, Khordha district, roughly 24 km south of Bhubaneswar city and about 4 km from Khurda Road Junction, a major railway junction on the Howrah-Chennai line.
